card.text: Explore Charon with New Horizons imagery, deep canyons and measured elevation.

introduction.text: Pluto’s largest moon is a world of deep canyons and broad icy plains. Charon and Pluto keep the same faces turned toward one another.

normal.title: Monochrome mosaic
normal.summary: Lighting is corrected, but local photographed shadows remain. Detail varies; the unobserved south is left unavailable.

enhanced-color.title: MVIC enhanced-color mosaic
enhanced-color.summary: Enhanced color combines MVIC near-infrared, red and blue bands, sharpened with panchromatic detail. It is not natural color or quantitative albedo. Gray grid marks missing color coverage; detail varies across the map.

elevation.title: Stereo and shading terrain model
elevation.summary: Stereo and shading height relative to a 606 km sphere. Detail varies; the gray grid marks missing data.

albedo.title: New Horizons modeled Bond albedo
albedo.summary: New Horizons photometric model estimating the fraction of sunlight reflected by Charon. Derived from LORRI brightness and scattering assumptions, not a direct bolometric measurement. Gray grid marks missing source cells and uncovered southern latitudes. Colors span 0.1–0.5; values beyond those limits use endpoint colors.
